nvitk.gui.io.export
===================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.io.export

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Export Napari layers to disk via :mod:`nvitk.io` writers.

---------

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: layer_to_image(layer: Any, *, use_file_affine: bool = True) -> nvitk.types.Image

   Build an :class:`~nvitk.types.Image` from a Napari layer (Image / Labels).


.. py:function:: layer_to_mesh(layer: Any) -> nvitk.types.Mesh

   Build a :class:`~nvitk.types.Mesh` from a Napari Surface layer.


.. py:function:: write_mesh_stl(path: str | pathlib.Path, mesh: nvitk.types.Mesh) -> None

   Write a mesh to ASCII STL (no extra dependencies).


.. py:function:: export_layer(layer: Any, path: str | pathlib.Path, *, use_file_affine=True, force_type=None) -> None

   Export the active Napari layer using nvitk I/O.


.. py:function:: export_selected_layer(viewer: Any, path: str, *, use_file_affine=True, force_type=None) -> None

   Export the selected layer, or the topmost layer if none selected.
